_comment: WS-0 machine-readable interlock ledger — the data half of the split merge-gate.
Its LOAD-BEARING CONSTANTS (gate_set, search_paths, exclude_paths, the engine-path + substrate
marker dicts incl. regexes, and 'every gate cell has a substrate marker') are PINNED against frozen values in
tests/test_split_interlock_tripwire_selftest.py — so a PR that edits this file to neuter the gate
(drop a gate cell, widen an exclude, delete a marker) must ALSO edit those frozen test constants,
which fails CI loudly and is a reviewable change (the ledger cannot silently disarm its own gate).
GREP LIMIT (acknowledged): markers prove STRING-PRESENCE, not semantic existence. A cell can be
flipped green off an incidental string match or a comment, and a renamed/synonym engine symbol or a
gitignored generated file evades RULE 1. The routed-concern row's human review is the compensating
control for substrate QUALITY and for the un-mechanizable nvd_*/vuln_finding disclosure path.
Update-on-close: a PR that lands a substrate item flips its cell to green HERE in the same PR;
the false-certification guard fails CI if a cell is green while its substrate marker is absent.

a.title: Phase-4 engine principals
a.note: RBAC-only enforcement shipped (auth_routes.cpp require_permission/require_scoped_permission engine branch). ADR-0032 (a) cell is STALE (says not shipped).

b.title: admit-then-filter gate + deny-precedence + evaluate-as-operator seam
b.note: authorize_list_read/require_list_read chokepoint SHIPPED + pinned ([1715]); #1715 landed ADDITIVE. TWO open halves: #2665 deny-precedence (a SEMANTIC change to the existing combining algorithm — NO grep symbol, so RULE 2 cannot verify it; flipping (b) green requires a HUMAN ATTESTATION that deny-precedence landed, not just the seam) and #2675 the evaluate_as_operator seam (a new symbol, the marker below).

c.title: D12 audit schema with indexed use_case_run_id
c.note: use_case_run_id = 0-in-code. AuditEvent has a single principal field.

d.title: P7 release-log schema
d.note: release-log store = 0-in-code (one comment forward-reference at authz_model.hpp:206). Born-on-PG store, ADR-0012.

e.title: G1 cross-process event transport
e.note: Gates Decision 9 only, not the merge-gate. Buses process-local. Rides HA WS-2a event_outbox.

f.title: per-action mutability in the plugin ABI
f.note: Gates fact-acquisition dispatch only. plugin.h is ALREADY YUZU_PLUGIN_ABI_VERSION 4 (YuzuActionDescriptor); RED because no per-action MUTABILITY field exists yet — the real change is an append-only v4->v5 bump, not v3->v4.

g.title: derived-state confinement
g.note: Gates any module persisting cross-run derived state. Nothing exists.

h.title: runtime capability-declaration registry + credential columns
h.note: Securables are a compile-time std::array<27> at rbac_store.cpp:559 with NO runtime create-path. Registry + admitting/requesting-credential columns UNBUILT. The substrate marker below pins the registry CREATE-PATH symbol only; the credential columns (ADR-0032:956) live on use_case_runs + the Execution Plan, which are ENGINE-PATH markers RULE 1 blocks pre-gate, so they cannot be mechanized here without deadlocking the interlock. Therefore, like (b)'s #2665 half, flipping (h) green REQUIRES a HUMAN ATTESTATION that the admitting/requesting-credential columns also landed — the registry symbol alone is NOT sufficient.

i.title: execution semantics: outcome correlation + coverage envelope
i.note: Gates every distributed fact read and effect. Coverage fields 0-in-code; workflow_engine.cpp marks steps successful on dispatch.

j.title: capability projection (generated OpenAPI + tools/list)
j.note: tools/list iterates a compile-time array; OpenAPI is a hand-typed literal. INV-31-4 test cannot exist until this lands.

k.title: operational readiness (new stores in readyz + reaper liveness)
k.note: Gates admitting a run in production. Six new stores, none in /readyz; reaper has no liveness signal.

l.title: intra-module cross-run isolation
l.note: Gates any module serving multiple operators' runs concurrently from one deployment. Nothing exists.

m.title: per-principal quota caps
m.note: PARTIAL, so NOT green: the #1973 base per-principal concurrency/rate cap SHIPPED (PrincipalQuota, max_concurrency=16, rate=20/s, wired into agent_service_impl/mcp_server/mcp_stream), but ADR-0032 (m) ALSO requires the 2b §5 invocation-grant outstanding-count + issuance-rate caps + dual-side debit under delegation, which are engine-path and 0-in-code. So ADR-0032's (m) 'none enforced' overstates the gap (the base cap ships) but is NOT wholesale stale.

n.title: credential predecessor/successor relation + terminal-reason classification
n.note: Gates approval-preserving rebind across credential rotation. Unbuilt; 2b must be amended.

excluded.plan_hash: Pre-existing dispatch-tag grammar (compute_plan_hash; the v1|<class>|<mutability>|<plan_hash_hex> command-capability tag), dozens of pre-existing hits led by command_capability_parsers.hpp. NOT the ADR-0032 Execution-Plan hash. Never treat as an engine-path marker.
excluded.use_case_run_id_as_engine_path: use_case_run_id is a SUBSTRATE marker (cell c, the D12 audit column WS-A6 must land), never an engine-path blocker — blocking its first occurrence would deadlock the interlock against itself.
excluded.nvd_and_vuln_finding: nvd_* and vuln_finding_store already exist as server-side NVD sync (not 0-in-code), so they are a REVIEW-ROUTING path trigger in the routed-concern row, NOT a CI symbol marker. A PR putting them behind an engine principal is caught by human review, not this grep.
